name: Saving Sunnyglade
summary: Demar Brant asks you to drive Twilight's Hammer forces from Sunnyglade, a settlement in Farholde's northwest. The people there have lost their homes and receive little help from Stormwind.

sections.title: A Lost Settlement
sections.body: Demar Brant speaks for Farholde's weary people, including refugees who escaped tragedy without their families. Stormwind has left them to manage with dwindling means. The Twilight's Hammer took a settlement in the northwest, and Demar asks you to clear its forces from Sunnyglade.

faq.answer: Demar Brant asks you to drive Twilight's Hammer forces from Sunnyglade.
The Twilight's Hammer took a settlement in Farholde's northwest.

faq.q: Who are the people in Farholde?
faq.answer: Many are refugees who escaped tragedy without their families.
Farholde has lost a settlement to the Twilight's Hammer, while its people have fewer means to fend for themselves.
